Component: SlidingTextCta
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@designcodeio/threeui/v/1.2.0
Repository: https://github.com/MengTo/threeui
Source file in the distribution: lib-dist/shaders/neuform-isolated/sources/sliding-text-cta.html.js

DocBogi adapts the component's paired sliding labels, opposing vertical motion,
opacity, blur, timing and easing into local CSS for the sample classification
button. The React wrapper, effect backgrounds, and bundled assets are omitted.

Component: DiagnosticsPanel
Source file in the distribution: lib-dist/shaders/neuform-isolated/sources/diagnostics-panel.html.js
Source sections: "3D Canvas Utilities", "Card 1: Fixed Cropping", and "Interactive & Shooting Lines"

DocBogi uses this component's isometric projectIso function, layered depth
offsets, and element-relative pointer coordinates for the sample document and
folder. DOM transforms are applied on pointer movement in place of the
continuously rendered canvas. Motion is optional and no runtime, artwork,
CDN script, or bundled asset from the component is shipped.
